top_5_citable.label: Moderate Citability
top_5_citable.preview: An environmental nonprofit migrated 70,000 donor records from a legacy database to Salesforce. The migration was done by a previous consultant without deduplication, field validation, or a test load reviewed...

top_5_citable.heading: Key Takeaways
top_5_citable.label: Moderate Citability
top_5_citable.preview: An environmental nonprofit migrated 70,000 donor records without deduplication, field validation, or a test load. A cents-to-dollars conversion error inflated every financial value by 100x. The pipeline dashboard showed $4.2M....

top_5_citable.heading: What CCC Did
top_5_citable.label: Moderate Citability
top_5_citable.preview: CCC ran SOQL validation queries against every donor-facing object. The audit quantified the damage: 12,000 duplicates, 8,000 orphans, 4,200 records with currency errors, and 15,000 records with non-standardized name formats...
